title: Sky Hopper
author: cobanov
description: Flap a low-poly bird through endless gaps between pipes high above the clouds, past the pipes that start to move, and chase the gold and platinum medals.

controls.A: Flap; pick a menu entry; play again
controls.D-pad: UP flaps, like A; UP / DOWN choose in menus
controls.B: Back in menus, resume; title from get ready and game over
